messages:
maya: seeing a sudden spike of 500/503s for hosted inference for customer `acme-corp` starting ~09:12 UTC. Gateway shows upstream worker reset and immediate 5xx. Opening thread with relevant logs below.

maya: root cause looks like an abrupt runner exit (container restart). sample from runner STDERR: 
```
[09:12:34] infer-runner[pid=2321] ERROR: CUDA error: out of memory
[09:12:34] infer-runner[pid=2321] INFO: trying graceful shutdown
[09:12:34] infer-runner[pid=2321] FATAL: illegal instruction at 0x7f4c1d2a5b
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

support_lead_zoe: customer is on a call, they report spikes every ~2-3 minutes, heavy tail on timeouts. they're asking for ETA. putting CS on standby. :exclamation:

dave_sre: copying logs i pulled from the node (container id 9f3c2a). saw repeated pattern: OOM -> SIGILL -> container restart. node id: ip-10-4-1-23. attaching minimal repro steps in case eng needs them.

eng_infer_max: we rolled a quant-runtime tweak last night for multi-gpu packing. could be an AVX/ptx kernel hitting an unsupported path on that driver. any chance this host has a different driver ABI?

ops_lucas: confirmed driver on ip-10-4-1-23 is `nvidia-driver 525.85` while fleet baseline is `530.x` in the region. that mismatch could trigger different PTX codegen. also found recent node reboot at 03:40 UTC.

maya: repro notes for SRE/ENG: this happens when requests include tool-calling and long-context (>8k tokens) on model `redwood-open-7b-quant`. steps:
1) send tool call payload with long system prompt (attached)
2) parallel QPS ~12 on that node
3) observe OOM then SIGILL within ~20s

maya: sample curl we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b-quant","input":"<long prompt>","stream":false}'
```

dave_sre: quick mitigation deployed: temporary routing rule to divert traffic for `acme-corp` to `redwood-open-7b-fp16` on CPU fallback pool. applied at 09:18 UTC. CS reported immediate drop in errors for that tenant.

eng_infer_max: thanks. I'll repro locally with the same driver matrix. please capture core and `libtorch`/runtime versions from the failing container. commands to run on node:
```bash
# collect core and runtime info
sudo journalctl -u infer-runner -n 200 > /tmp/infer-journal.log
docker cp 9f3c2a:/var/crash/core.2321 /tmp/core.2321 || true
strings /tmp/core.2321 | egrep -i 'libtorch|redwood_runtime|cuda' > /tmp/core_syms.txt
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv
```
```
# capture kernel dmesg around crash
sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg_crash.log
```

ops_lucas: running those now, will upload to the incident bucket and paste link. also enabling nvml logging and `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` for the next 15m.

srebot: ALERT: fallback routing applied for tenant=acme-corp -> route id r-8f3b. Errors for tenant decreased from 42/min to 3/min.

maya: paste from journal around crash: 
```
Sep 12 09:12:33 infer-runner[2321]: mem_alloc failed: attempted 11.2GB but only 10.7GB free
Sep 12 09:12:34 infer-runner[2321]: attempt quantized kernel launch: attention_kv_prefetch.cu:421
Sep 12 09:12:34 infer-runner[2321]: runtime abort: PTX_INVALID_INSTR
Sep 12 09:12:34 kernel: pid 2321 (infer-runner) caused SIGILL at 7f4c1d2a5b
```

eng_infer_max: PTX_INVALID_INSTR is consistent with driver/kernel mismatch or generating an instruction set not supported by GPU. if we can repro with the older driver we should see same SIGILL. next steps:
- I'll build a debug image with logging around the attention kernel paths and run against both driver versions.
- check whether the quant-runtime picked a new kernel via env var `RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=packed_attn_v2` — if so, revert.

dave_sre: ops_lucas uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/1718254322/artifacts.tar.gz (journal, dmesg, core, nvidia-smi output). link shared with eng.

ops_lucas: temp mitigation idea: add a guard in the orchestrator to block kernel selection of `packed_attn_v2` for drivers < 530. applying Canary patch to disable that kernel on nodes reporting driver<530.

support_lead_zoe: CS update sent: we explained we applied traffic diversion and are investigating root cause with eng. asked customer whether they prefer immediate full failover or gradual. they want failover until fix.

eng_infer_max: agree with blocking kernel selection. I'll also run a quick test: force `RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=compat_v1` and run the long prompt workload. if green, schedule a rollback of the quant-runtime change.

maya: follow-up: billing impact note — some customers retried heavily and incurred extra token charges. ops/legal asked to flag affected accounts for manual crediting if appropriate. Zoe to coordinate.

support_lead_zoe: noted, will open a billing review ticket and mark `acme-corp` for client credit review.

dave_sre: next oncall handoff at 10:00 UTC — leaving notes in the incident doc with actions: artifacts uploaded, fallback applied, kernel block in flight.

eng_infer_max: created draft PR to disable packed_attn_v2 on old drivers and a hotfix pipeline to rollout to affected hosts. tagging @ops for canary. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3456

ops_lucas: canary applied to 4 nodes, no regressions seen in 20m. rolling to remaining pool.

maya: closing loop here — will keep thread updates if we see further restarts. thanks all. :thumbsup:
